lines: For full-year fiscal 2026, on a constant currency basis relative to fiscal 2025, we expect revenue in the range of $830 million to $840 million and non-GAAP EBITDA margin in the range

“We expect that the constant currency adjustment will decrease CRA’s reported annual revenue by approximately $2.9 million and will decrease CRA’s reported annual EBITDA by approximately $0.4 million for fiscal 2026.

As previously reported, non-cash forgivable loan amortization, which is reflected as an expense when presenting EBITDA metrics, is expected to increase in fiscal 2026 by approximately $15 million, reflecting investments in talent to drive profitable growth (approximately $14 million of this increase has been booked through the first three quarters of fiscal 2026).
